mentions.name: Opacity Tech
mentions.description: Web design and IT consulting company that builds websites with handwritten, optimized, fast code and runs its own in-house servers instead of cloud services. It avoids AI-generated code, template-based site builders, rented platforms, and subscription/licensing fees, which lets it charge lower prices.
mentions.problem: Template-based site builders and AI agents produce bloated, slow code, while rented platforms, subscriptions, licenses, and cloud services drive up costs.
mentions.source_excerpt: Recently started a web design and IT consulting company called Opacity Tech with a simple goal, reasonable prices, and handwritten code. No AI agents writing bloated code, no template based site builders.

evidence.value: Recently started a web design and IT consulting company called Opacity Tech with a simple goal, reasonable prices, and handwritten code. No AI agents writing bloated code, no template based site builders.
